fusions.name: Threaded Point
fusions.desc: Passes a needle through the gap in the target's armour, dealing 32 damage that ignores armour and leaving the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Basting Stitch
fusions.desc: Pricks the target for 4 damage and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Stitch Closed
fusions.desc: Sews your wounds shut, restoring 20 health to you. Its healing rises +8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%).

fusions.name: Fine Seam
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%. You regenerate 0.5 health a second.
